Instrument Enclosure/chassis.reasoning: Used in rugged or laboratory environments for chassis requiring greater robustness, though less typical than aluminum.

Column Oven.name: Aluminum
Column Oven.reasoning: Used for the oven body and heat conduction parts due to thermal conductivity and corrosion resistance.

Column Oven.name: Ceramic
Column Oven.reasoning: Used for insulation and heating elements in ovens due to high temperature stability.

Column Oven.name: PTFE
Column Oven.reasoning: Used for seals and tubing inside column oven area for chemical resistance, though alternatives exist.

Degassing Unit.name: Stainless steel
Degassing Unit.reasoning: Structural and fluid-contact parts need corrosion resistance; stainless steel is industry standard.

Degassing Unit.name: Glass
Degassing Unit.reasoning: Used in degassing membranes, sight windows or reservoirs for chemical resistance and transparency.

Degassing Unit.name: PTFE
Degassing Unit.reasoning: Tubing and sealing components require chemical resistance; PTFE is standard choice.
